title: 식당에서 음식이 잘못 나왔을 때: 이건 제 음식이 아니에요
objective: You can say "this is not my food" with N이/가 아니에요 and ask for a change.
summary: Learn to politely tell restaurant staff that your food is wrong.
setting: A Korean restaurant at lunchtime. A customer ordered 된장찌개 (soybean paste stew), but the server brought the wrong dish.

task.title: Fix the food problem
task.line: Read each situation, then choose, fill in, put in order, or write what you would say to the server.

words.meaning: to come out, to be served

words.exampleMeaning: Could you change this cup, please?

words.meaning: to be cold (to the touch, e.g., food or drink)

words.exampleMeaning: The soup is a little salty.

words.meaning: it is not N (이 after a consonant, 가 after a vowel)
words.exampleMeaning: This isn't milk. It's soy milk.

dialogue.korean: 이건 제 음식이 아니에요. 저는 된장찌개를 시켰어요.
dialogue.meaning: This is not my food. I ordered doenjang-jjigae.
Oh, I'm sorry. I'll change it right away.

exercises: Choose the right word: You ordered bibimbap, but you got bulgogi. 이건 (비빔밥이 / 비빔밥을) 아니에요.
Fill in the blank with 이 or 가: ① 이건 제 커피__ 아니에요. ② 이건 라면__ 아니에요.
Fill in the blank with 짜요, 차가워요, or 나왔어요: ① There is too much salt. 이 김치찌개가 너무 ____. ② 커피가 ____. 따뜻한 커피 주세요. ③ 30분 기다렸어요. 제 음식이 아직 안 ____.
Put the words in order to ask for a new spoon: 주세요 / 이 / 바꿔 / 숟가락 좀
Answer in Korean: You ordered 김밥, but the server brings you 냉면. Tell the server it is not your food and say what you ordered.
answers: ① 짜요 ② 차가워요 ③ 나왔어요
이건 제 음식이 아니에요. 저는 김밥을 시켰어요. (이거 제 음식이 아니에요. 저는 김밥을 시켰어요.)
